name: comet
description: COMET: Catalyst Overall Manufacturing Estimation Tool — Windows desktop app for catalyst cost estimation and source-linked benchmark workflows
author: hyunjin.kang
//port: 8765 must match BACKEND_PORT in electron/main.js (single source of truth)

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run electron:wait"
scripts.dev:frontend: cross-env VITE_BACKEND_PORT=8765 cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.electron:wait: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/health http://localhost:5173 && npm run electron:dev
scripts.web: npm run build:frontend && npm run desktop:stop && uvicorn backend.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend-sidecar && npm run electron:build
scripts.pack: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend-sidecar && npm run desktop:stop && electron-builder --dir
scripts.pack:smoke: npm run pack && npm run smoke:desktop
